notes: PDF is the HAL author manuscript (hal-03161863) of the ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2021 research article; not a thesis or review. H2 uptake measured volumetrically (Micromeritics HPVA II, 77-273 K, up to ~14-15 MPa; plus 3-Flex at 77 K up to 0.1 MPa) on six commercial activated carbons; values reported as excess. BET areas for all six samples are also in SI Table S1 (si1, p. 2), with N2 BET P/P0 ranges and Rouquerol criterion stated (main p. 8, Section 2.2). Minor inconsistency: MSC30 ABET is 3310 m2 g-1 in the main text but 3305 m2 g-1 in Table S1. duplicate_data not applied: the paper says its previous study (ref 31) measured H2 adsorption on MSC30 and MSP20X, but it does not state that the values reported here were published before, and four other carbons are new.
